name: @hydranium/bookstore-server
description: Bookstore language server, built with the Hydranium framework.

scripts.clean: rimraf lib syntaxes src/language-server/generated src/language-server/generated-hydranium test/generated-hydranium tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.generate: npm run langium:generate && npm run generate:transfer-model
scripts.generate:transfer-model: hydranium-cli generate-transfer-model --ast-file src/language-server/generated/ast.ts --augmentation-file src/language-server/ast.ts --out-file ../protocol/src/generated-hydranium/transfer-model.ts --ast-builder-file src/language-server/generated-hydranium/ast-builder.ts --transfer-builder-file test/generated-hydranium/transfer-builder.ts --languages-file ../protocol/src/generated-hydranium/languages.ts --element-type-name BookstoreElement --terminals-name BookstoreTerminals --regen-command "Run: npm --prefix examples/bookstore/server run generate:transfer-model"
